credits.art: Vusi Malindi, Alice Toich, Jesse Breytenbach, Wiehan de Jager, Mia du Plessis, Karlien de Villiers, Cathy Feek, Franz Phooko

p: This is my teacher. Her name is Teacher Mulongo. She loves me a lot.
Teacher Mulongo teaches us the alphabet and the vowels. I can say the letters a, e, i, o, u.
she has taught us the colours red, blue, green, yellow and orange.
During nap time Teacher Mulongo sings us to sleep. She sings a lullaby to us.
The lullaby goes like this: Jonnie ,Jonnie yes Mama eating sugar? No Mama, open your mouth haaha...haaha.
Teacher Mulongo knows many stories. She tells us a different story each day of the week.
On Monday, she tells us stories about great men.
On Tuesday, she tells us stories about great women.
On Wednesday, she tells us stories about special days.
On Thursday, she tells us stories about our environment.
And on Friday, Teacher Mulongo asks us to tell our own stories to the class.
Our teacher is the best teacher in the world! When I grow up, I want to be a teacher.
